channel.title: Stuff Seth Thinks Is Cool
channel.description: Selected software-development links Seth saves, curated with Goose.

item.title: AI Engineering from Scratch
item.description: A deep AI engineering curriculum that builds backprop, tokenizers, attention, and agent loops by hand before leaning on frameworks. (aiengineeringfromscratch.com)

item.title: How I Stopped Running out of Tokens
item.description: A practical field guide to reducing Claude Code token burn through better tooling, settings, and habits in day-to-day agentic coding. (danielabaron.me)

item.title: Flue 2.0
item.description: Flue 2.0 is a stable TypeScript agent-framework release with dynamic agents and a hooks-based API; worth a look for agent orchestration patterns. (flueframework.com)

item.title: My Agentic Coding Setup, July 2026
item.description: Domenic Denicola walks through an autonomous, parallel, remotely reachable agentic coding setup—the useful part is the system design, not just the tool list. (domenic.me)

item.title: ai-boost/awesome-harness-engineering
item.description: An awesome list for AI agent harness engineering, covering evals, memory, MCP, permissions, observability, orchestration, and related tooling. (github.com)

item.title: grilling-frontend-prototyping skill
item.description: A reusable agent skill for frontend prototyping workflows; useful as a concrete example of encoding engineering taste and review heuristics into instructions. (github.com)

item.title: mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne
item.description: Mnemosyne pitches a zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system for Hermes agents and other AI tooling; interesting infrastructure for agent recall. (github.com)

item.title: Pixi Documentation
item.description: Pixi is a next-gen package manager for reproducible development environments; useful if you want Conda-style project setup with a modern workflow. (pixi.prefix.dev)

item.title: jcode - open-source AI coding agent for the terminal
item.description: jcode is a Rust-based terminal coding agent focused on fast startup, durable memory, background tasks, and multi-agent swarm workflows. (jcode.sh)

item.title: Local Hoster source code — prototyped
item.description: A zero-runtime-dependency Node CLI that gives local projects stable localhost URLs, so you stop chasing whatever port a dev server picked today. (prototyped.dev)

item.title: Beautiful logging for TypeScript
item.description: tslog is a fast, expressive logger for TypeScript and JavaScript projects, aimed at making structured logging pleasant without much ceremony. (tslog.js.org)

item.title: Writing rules for CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
item.description: A short thread applying Orwell-style clarity rules to CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md instructions: simplify prose, but do not blur code or technical terms. (x.com)

item.title: Astro Content Collections
item.description: Astro's content collections are a clean fit for this site: each saved link can live as typed Markdown, while the build gets schema validation before anything publishes. (docs.astro.build)
